description: This file contains data transfer object (DTO) definitions for defects, including create, update, and response representations used in the API layer of the system.

classes.name: DefectDtos
classes.description: Container class holding DTO record definitions for defect-related API requests and responses.

methods.name: DefectCreateRequest
methods.description: Record representing data required to create a new defect.

methods.name: DefectUpdateRequest
methods.description: Record representing data to update an existing defect.

methods.name: DefectResponse
methods.description: Record representing defect details returned in API responses.
